name: Team Charmander: Hyper-Offense & Early Fusion Breakers
archetype: High-velocity physical breakers, Mankey/Spearow hybrid speed, and sleep status control to bypass Rock weaknesses.
gym_duel_rationale: Brock enforces a strict 2v2 duel. Charmander takes 4x lethal rock damage and must be safely benched! Duel with Butterfree/Beedrill (Confusion targeting Brock's low SpD) and Mankey/Spearow (weight-scaled Low Kick to crush Onix).

roster.progression_notes: Charmander takes 4x lethal damage from Rock Throw. Bench Charmander for Gym 1; fusions solve Brock effortlessly.
Fused from Route 22 catches. Blistering early speed (Spe 70) and Defiant attack. Low Kick destroys Onix in two hits.
Confusion targets Brock's weak Special Defense (Geodude SpD 30, Onix SpD 45), bypassing physical rock armor.
Grass/Flying typing gives complete immunity to Ground-type attacks and provides secondary Sleep Powder backup.

flex_bench.why_use: Caught on Route 1 or Route 22. Hyper Fang and Guts-boosted attacks provide reliable neutral physical burst damage.
Route 22 catch. Early access to Double Kick at Lv. 12 and Moon Stone at Mt. Moon.

active_fusions: Mankey/Spearow (Early Fighting/Flying speed breaker and Onix wallbreaker)
Butterfree/Beedrill (Bug/Poison status duo with 97.5% accurate Sleep Powder)
Tangela/Pidgey (Grass/Flying aerial pivot with Vine Whip)
unfuse_recommendations: 1. Retain Mankey/Spearow for high physical speed through Mt. Moon.
2. In Chapter 2, purchase Super Splicers at Cerulean Poké Mart ($300 at any Mart) to fuse Charmeleon with Kadabra.
upcoming_fusions: Bellsprout/Butterfree (Misty's Water Gym counter in Chapter 2)
